title: Connecting refinement with another indice
body:
Hi!

I have been searching about this but I havent gotten very far. Basically I am trying to connect my hierarchicalMenu with another indice. Like this:

Right now I have 2 indices. One containing songs, and another one containing taxonomies for the songs (genres).
The song indice also have an attribute called genre, which can connect it to the genre indice.

The genre indices include information about the genre, for example a description of "Rock" and an icon.

I am displaying results from the song indices to the users, with genre as a hierarchicalMenu. However, since this is just a refinement of the "Genre"-attribute, this list is not connected to the Genre indices at all.

So for example, if I wanna display the icon for each genre next to the refinement list, what would be the strategy for this? They both have a matching key which can use to connect the attribute to the entry in the genre indices.

Does anybody know of an example where anything similar is done? Or what is the correct way to approach this.
